summary: Iteration 140 verification (Peripherals + auto-badge + Dashboard backlog cleanups): 6 new backend tests (TestAutoIssueBadge x5 + TestStoreSettingsPeripherals x1) all pass, full regression 110/110 still green (116/116 total). Frontend Playwright confirmed: Peripherals block renders inside Store Settings dialog with all 4 controls (peripheral-settings-block, auto-print-receipt-checkbox, auto-issue-badge-checkbox, badge-label-size-select + Default print mode); WalletBadgePage auto-fires window.print() ONLY when ?print=1 is present (verified by stubbing window.print); Dashboard visibilitychange dispatch handled cleanly with no JS errors. /api/badges/auto-issue endpoint is idempotent in live network calls (was_created flips false on repeat). Code-level verification of cp-issue-badge-btn (correctly gated on decision==='approved' + supported subject kinds) and KioskPage kioskAutoIssueBadge wiring confirms the flows are implemented as specified.

endpoints_verified: POST /api/badges/auto-issue — 401 unauth, 400 missing fields, 400 unsupported kind, 404 unknown subject_id, 200 first-call returns full badge with was_created=true + token + issued_via='auto_kiosk' + issued_by audit, 200 second-call returns same token with was_created=false (idempotent), no _id leak

PUT /api/store-settings/{location_id} — accepts auto_print_receipt, auto_issue_badge, badge_label_size, print_mode and persists them; GET /api/store-settings/{location_id} returns them back; toggling off persists correctly
critical_code_review_comments: WalletBadgePage auto-print fires inside useEffect — in React 18 StrictMode dev builds this means window.print() fires twice on mount. Harmless in production but visible during dev/playwright runs. Consider a useRef guard if cleaner dev behavior is desired.

auto_issue_badge endpoint short-circuits on existing badge BEFORE resolving the subject — fast path is correct, but it also bypasses the subject-existence check. Calling auto-issue on a member_id that already has a wallet_badge but whose member record was deleted will silently return the orphaned badge. Edge case, low priority — consider also verifying subject exists when returning existing.
KioskPage.kioskAutoIssueBadge swallows badge-issue errors silently via console.warn — toast.info / visible UI surfacing could help kiosk staff diagnose printer or auth issues. Minor UX.

ProductsPage post-sale window.print() is bound to a 600ms timeout with no cleanup. If the user navigates away between sale-complete and the timer firing, the print dialog still triggers — minor, but a useRef + cleanup in unmount would be more correct.

/app/frontend/src/pages/SecurityCheckpointPage.jsx is 913 lines — still over the 700-line guideline noted in iter139. Splitting SecurityView, PairView, and the modals into separate files would help maintainability.
/app/backend/routers/members.py is now 1846 lines — long overdue for split (badges, audit, member-CRUD into sub-routers).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the flows tested (peripherals dialog renders, badge auto-print works only with ?print=1, visibility-API dispatch clean, auto-issue API idempotent)

seed_data_creation: Test member created per-test with TEST_Iter140_<uuid> prefix and torn down after; store_settings for first location is mutated then restored (toggled off) at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter140 brings backend regression to 116 tests. The 6 new tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration140_peripherals_autobadge.py (~2s runtime). Key gotchas: (a) the iter140 fixture uses a randomized phone +25670<7-digits-from-time> to avoid duplicate-detection 409s against pre-seeded TEST_NewUser records; (b) auto-issue endpoint is idempotent on member_id and returns was_created=false if a non-invalidated badge already exists. (c) cp-issue-badge-btn only renders when decision==='approved' AND subject.kind in {member,child,guest,user} — full E2E of that flow requires a paired security session + an approved scan, which couldn't be exercised in headless Playwright in this iteration; source-level verification was done instead. (d) KioskPage kioskAutoIssueBadge only fires when store_settings.auto_issue_badge=true on the kiosk's selectedLocation — flip via PUT /api/store-settings/<loc> if you want to E2E-test it. (e) WalletBadgePage fires window.print twice in React dev StrictMode — that's expected, not a bug. Dashboard LiveCheckpointWidget hides when zero checkpoints exist (same as iter139).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all features verified working as specified.
